dialogue.text: It's me, Little Lamb.
dialogue.zh: 是我，小羊。
dialogue.ja: 僕だよ、小さな子羊。
dialogue.local: It's me, Little Lamb.
dialogue.en: It's me, Little Lamb.

dialogue.text: Tonight, I have a very special story to share with you.
dialogue.zh: 今晚，我有一個非常特別的故事要和你分享。
dialogue.ja: 今夜、とても特別なお話を君に伝えたいんだ。
dialogue.local: Tonight, I have a very special story to share with you.
dialogue.en: Tonight, I have a very special story to share with you.

dialogue.text: It's about love, courage, and the most wonderful gift anyone has ever given.
dialogue.zh: 這是關於愛、勇氣，以及世上最美好的禮物。
dialogue.ja: それは愛と勇気、そして誰かが贈った最も素晴らしい贈り物についての話だよ。
dialogue.local: It's about love, courage, and the most wonderful gift anyone has ever given.
dialogue.en: It's about love, courage, and the most wonderful gift anyone has ever given.

dialogue.text: It's the true story of Easter.
dialogue.zh: 這是真實的復活節故事。
dialogue.ja: これはイースターの本当の物語なんだ。
dialogue.local: It's the true story of Easter.
dialogue.en: It's the true story of Easter.

dialogue.text: Are you ready?
dialogue.zh: 你準備好了嗎？
dialogue.ja: 準備はいいかな？
dialogue.local: Are you ready?
dialogue.en: Are you ready?

dialogue.text: Let's begin.
dialogue.zh: 讓我們開始吧。
dialogue.ja: さあ、始めよう。
dialogue.local: Let's begin.
dialogue.en: Let's begin.

dialogue.text: One day, Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a little donkey.
dialogue.zh: 有一天，耶穌騎著一匹小驢子進入了耶路撒冷城。
dialogue.ja: ある日、イエスは小さなロバに乗ってエルサレムの街に入った。
dialogue.local: One day, Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a little donkey.
dialogue.en: One day, Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a little donkey.

dialogue.text: Crowds gathered waving palm branches and shouting,
dialogue.zh: 人群聚集，揮舞著棕櫚枝，大聲歡呼，
dialogue.ja: 群衆が集まり、ヤシの枝を振りながら叫んだ、
dialogue.local: Crowds gathered waving palm branches and shouting,
dialogue.en: Crowds gathered waving palm branches and shouting,

dialogue.text: Oh, Santa, they were so happy to see him.
dialogue.zh: 哦，聖者，他們看到他非常高興。
dialogue.ja: ああ、聖なる方、彼らは彼に会えてとても嬉しかった。
dialogue.local: Oh, Santa, they were so happy to see him.
dialogue.en: Oh, Santa, they were so happy to see him.

dialogue.text: Jesus was their king.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌是他們的王。
dialogue.ja: イエスは彼らの王だった。
dialogue.local: Jesus was their king.
dialogue.en: Jesus was their king.

dialogue.text: Come to bring peace and love.
dialogue.zh: 來帶來和平與愛。
dialogue.ja: 平和と愛をもたらすために来たのだ。
dialogue.local: Come to bring peace and love.
dialogue.en: Come to bring peace and love.

dialogue.text: Later that week, Jesus had a special dinner with his closest friends.
dialogue.zh: 那週晚些時候，耶穌與他最親密的朋友們共進特別的晚餐。
dialogue.ja: その週の後半、イエスは親しい友達と特別な夕食をとった。
dialogue.local: Later that week, Jesus had a special dinner with his closest friends.
dialogue.en: Later that week, Jesus had a special dinner with his closest friends.

dialogue.text: He broke bread and shared a cup, saying,
dialogue.zh: 他掰開餅，分享杯子，說：
dialogue.ja: 彼はパンを割り、杯を分け合いながら言った、
dialogue.local: He broke bread and shared a cup, saying,
dialogue.en: He broke bread and shared a cup, saying,

dialogue.text: This is my body.
dialogue.zh: 這是我的身體。
dialogue.ja: これは私の体です。
dialogue.local: This is my body.
dialogue.en: This is my body.

dialogue.text: And this is my blood, given for you.
dialogue.zh: 這是為你們流出的血。
dialogue.ja: そしてこれはあなたたちのために流す私の血です。
dialogue.local: And this is my blood, given for you.
dialogue.en: And this is my blood, given for you.

dialogue.text: Jesus knew something very hard was about to happen.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌知道將有非常艱難的事情即將發生。
dialogue.ja: イエスはとても辛いことが起こることを知っていた。
dialogue.local: Jesus knew something very hard was about to happen.
dialogue.en: Jesus knew something very hard was about to happen.

dialogue.text: But he wanted his friends to know how much he loved them.
dialogue.zh: 但他想讓朋友們知道他有多愛他們。
dialogue.ja: でも彼は友達にどれほど愛しているか伝えたかった。
dialogue.local: But he wanted his friends to know how much he loved them.
dialogue.en: But he wanted his friends to know how much he loved them.

dialogue.text: Then Jesus gave them a promise.
dialogue.zh: 然後耶穌給了他們一個承諾。
dialogue.ja: そしてイエスは約束をした。
dialogue.local: Then Jesus gave them a promise.
dialogue.en: Then Jesus gave them a promise.

dialogue.text: He said, I will go away for a little while, but don't be afraid.
dialogue.zh: 他說，我將離開一會兒，但不要害怕。
dialogue.ja: 彼は言った、しばらくの間いなくなるけど、怖がらないでね。
dialogue.local: He said, I will go away for a little while, but don't be afraid.
dialogue.en: He said, I will go away for a little while, but don't be afraid.

dialogue.text: I will come back to life again.
dialogue.zh: 我會再度復活。
dialogue.ja: また生き返るよ。
dialogue.local: I will come back to life again.
dialogue.en: I will come back to life again.

dialogue.text: His friends didn't fully understand.
dialogue.zh: 他的朋友們並不完全理解。
dialogue.ja: 友達は完全には理解できなかった。
dialogue.local: His friends didn't fully understand.
dialogue.en: His friends didn't fully understand.

dialogue.text: But Jesus was sharing a hope that would soon change the world.
dialogue.zh: 但耶穌分享了一個很快會改變世界的希望。
dialogue.ja: でもイエスは、すぐに世界を変える希望を伝えていた。
dialogue.local: But Jesus was sharing a hope that would soon change the world.
dialogue.en: But Jesus was sharing a hope that would soon change the world.

dialogue.text: That night, Jesus went to a quiet garden to pray.
dialogue.zh: 那天晚上，耶穌去了安靜的花園祈禱。
dialogue.ja: その夜、イエスは静かな庭に行って祈った。
dialogue.local: That night, Jesus went to a quiet garden to pray.
dialogue.en: That night, Jesus went to a quiet garden to pray.

dialogue.text: He felt sad and afraid.
dialogue.zh: 他感到悲傷和害怕。
dialogue.ja: 彼は悲しくて怖かった。
dialogue.local: He felt sad and afraid.
dialogue.en: He felt sad and afraid.

dialogue.text: He asked God for strength because he knew what was coming.
dialogue.zh: 他向上帝祈求力量，因為他知道將要發生什麼。
dialogue.ja: 彼はこれから起こることを知っていたので、神に力を求めた。
dialogue.local: He asked God for strength because he knew what was coming.
dialogue.en: He asked God for strength because he knew what was coming.

dialogue.text: Jesus chose to obey, even though it would be hard.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌選擇服從，儘管這很艱難。
dialogue.ja: イエスは難しくても従うことを選んだ。
dialogue.local: Jesus chose to obey, even though it would be hard.
dialogue.en: Jesus chose to obey, even though it would be hard.

dialogue.text: Because he loves us so much.
dialogue.zh: 因為他非常愛我們。
dialogue.ja: それは彼が私たちをとても愛しているからだ。
dialogue.local: Because he loves us so much.
dialogue.en: Because he loves us so much.

dialogue.text: While Jesus prayed, a group of soldiers came to the garden.
dialogue.zh: 當耶穌祈禱時，一群士兵來到了花園。
dialogue.ja: イエスが祈っている間に、兵士たちが庭にやって来た。
dialogue.local: While Jesus prayed, a group of soldiers came to the garden.
dialogue.en: While Jesus prayed, a group of soldiers came to the garden.

dialogue.text: They were led by a man named Judas, one of Jesus' own followers.
dialogue.zh: 他們由一個名叫猶大的男子帶領，他是耶穌的跟隨者之一。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはユダという男に率いられていた。彼はイエスの弟子の一人だった。
dialogue.local: They were led by a man named Judas, one of Jesus' own followers.
dialogue.en: They were led by a man named Judas, one of Jesus' own followers.

dialogue.text: Judas had chosen to betray Jesus and helped the leaders who were angry with him.
dialogue.zh: 猶大選擇背叛耶穌，並幫助那些對他生氣的領袖們。
dialogue.ja: ユダはイエスを裏切ることを選び、怒っている指導者たちを助けた。
dialogue.local: Judas had chosen to betray Jesus and helped the leaders who were angry with him.
dialogue.en: Judas had chosen to betray Jesus and helped the leaders who were angry with him.

dialogue.text: They didn't believe Jesus was the son of God.
dialogue.zh: 他們不相信耶穌是上帝的兒子。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはイエスが神の子だとは信じなかった。
dialogue.local: They didn't believe Jesus was the son of God.
dialogue.en: They didn't believe Jesus was the son of God.

dialogue.text: And they were afraid of the love and truth he taught.
dialogue.zh: 他們害怕他所教導的愛與真理。
dialogue.ja: そして彼が教えた愛と真実を恐れていた。
dialogue.local: And they were afraid of the love and truth he taught.
dialogue.en: And they were afraid of the love and truth he taught.

dialogue.text: So they had him arrested.
dialogue.zh: 所以他們逮捕了他。
dialogue.ja: だから彼らはイエスを逮捕した。
dialogue.local: So they had him arrested.
dialogue.en: So they had him arrested.

dialogue.text: Even though Jesus had done nothing wrong.
dialogue.zh: 儘管耶穌什麼錯都沒犯。
dialogue.ja: イエスは何も悪いことをしていなかったのに。
dialogue.local: Even though Jesus had done nothing wrong.
dialogue.en: Even though Jesus had done nothing wrong.

dialogue.text: But Jesus didn't run away.
dialogue.zh: 但耶穌沒有逃跑。
dialogue.ja: でもイエスは逃げなかった。
dialogue.local: But Jesus didn't run away.
dialogue.en: But Jesus didn't run away.

dialogue.text: He knew this was part of God's plan to save the world.
dialogue.zh: 他知道這是上帝拯救世界計劃的一部分。
dialogue.ja: これは神の世界を救う計画の一部だと知っていた。
dialogue.local: He knew this was part of God's plan to save the world.
dialogue.en: He knew this was part of God's plan to save the world.

dialogue.text: Jesus was taken to a place called Calvary, where he was put on a cross.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌被帶到一個叫髑髏地的地方，並被釘在十字架上。
dialogue.ja: イエスはゴルゴタという場所に連れて行かれ、十字架にかけられた。
dialogue.local: Jesus was taken to a place called Calvary, where he was put on a cross.
dialogue.en: Jesus was taken to a place called Calvary, where he was put on a cross.

dialogue.text: Even though he had the power to stop everything, Jesus chose to stay,
dialogue.zh: 儘管他有能力阻止一切，耶穌選擇留下，
dialogue.ja: すべてを止める力があったのに、イエスは留まることを選んだ、
dialogue.local: Even though he had the power to stop everything, Jesus chose to stay,
dialogue.en: Even though he had the power to stop everything, Jesus chose to stay,

dialogue.text: because he was rescuing us.
dialogue.zh: 因為他正在拯救我們。
dialogue.ja: それは私たちを救うためだったからだ。
dialogue.local: because he was rescuing us.
dialogue.en: because he was rescuing us.

dialogue.text: He took the punishment for all the wrong things people had done and would ever do.
dialogue.zh: 他承擔了人們所犯過和將會犯的所有錯誤的懲罰。
dialogue.ja: 彼は人々が犯した、そしてこれから犯すすべての罪の罰を受けた。
dialogue.local: He took the punishment for all the wrong things people had done and would ever do.
dialogue.en: He took the punishment for all the wrong things people had done and would ever do.

dialogue.text: Jesus forgave the people who hurt him.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌原諒了傷害他的人。
dialogue.ja: イエスは自分を傷つけた人々を許した。
dialogue.local: Jesus forgave the people who hurt him.
dialogue.en: Jesus forgave the people who hurt him.

dialogue.text: He looked at the sky and said,
dialogue.zh: 他望向天空說，
dialogue.ja: 彼は空を見上げて言った、
dialogue.local: He looked at the sky and said,
dialogue.en: He looked at the sky and said,

dialogue.text: Father, I place my life in your hands.
dialogue.zh: 父啊，我將我的生命交在你手中。
dialogue.ja: 父よ、私の命をあなたの手に委ねます。
dialogue.local: Father, I place my life in your hands.
dialogue.en: Father, I place my life in your hands.

dialogue.text: Then Jesus took his last breath and everything grew quiet.
dialogue.zh: 然後耶穌斷了最後一口氣，一切變得寂靜。
dialogue.ja: そしてイエスは最後の息を引き取り、すべてが静かになった。
dialogue.local: Then Jesus took his last breath and everything grew quiet.
dialogue.en: Then Jesus took his last breath and everything grew quiet.

dialogue.text: But this was not the end.
dialogue.zh: 但這不是結束。
dialogue.ja: しかし、これは終わりではなかった。
dialogue.local: But this was not the end.
dialogue.en: But this was not the end.

dialogue.text: Jesus had made a promise.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌曾許下承諾。
dialogue.ja: イエスは約束をしていた。
dialogue.local: Jesus had made a promise.
dialogue.en: Jesus had made a promise.

dialogue.text: I will rise again.
dialogue.zh: 我會再度復活。
dialogue.ja: 私はまたよみがえる。
dialogue.local: I will rise again.
dialogue.en: I will rise again.

dialogue.text: And even in the stillness, God's plan of love wasn't over.
dialogue.zh: 即使在寂靜中，上帝的愛的計劃仍未結束。
dialogue.ja: 静けさの中でも、神の愛の計画は終わっていなかった。
dialogue.local: And even in the stillness, God's plan of love wasn't over.
dialogue.en: And even in the stillness, God's plan of love wasn't over.

dialogue.text: Jesus' friends were very sad.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌的朋友們非常難過。
dialogue.ja: イエスの友達はとても悲しんだ。
dialogue.local: Jesus' friends were very sad.
dialogue.en: Jesus' friends were very sad.

dialogue.text: They gently placed his body in a tomb.
dialogue.zh: 他們輕輕地將他的身體放入墳墓。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはそっと彼の体を墓に置いた。
dialogue.local: They gently placed his body in a tomb.
dialogue.en: They gently placed his body in a tomb.

dialogue.text: And a big stone was rolled in front.
dialogue.zh: 並且一塊大石頭被滾到墓口前。
dialogue.ja: そして大きな石が墓の前に転がされた。
dialogue.local: And a big stone was rolled in front.
dialogue.en: And a big stone was rolled in front.

dialogue.text: But early on Sunday morning, something amazing happened.
dialogue.zh: 但在星期天清晨，發生了奇妙的事情。
dialogue.ja: しかし日曜日の早朝、驚くべきことが起こった。
dialogue.local: But early on Sunday morning, something amazing happened.
dialogue.en: But early on Sunday morning, something amazing happened.

dialogue.text: An angel came and rolled the stone away.
dialogue.zh: 一位天使來了，將石頭滾開。
dialogue.ja: 天使が来て石を転がした。
dialogue.local: An angel came and rolled the stone away.
dialogue.en: An angel came and rolled the stone away.

dialogue.text: The tomb was empty.
dialogue.zh: 墳墓是空的。
dialogue.ja: 墓は空っぽだった。
dialogue.local: The tomb was empty.
dialogue.en: The tomb was empty.

dialogue.text: Jesus wasn't there.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌不在那裡。
dialogue.ja: イエスはいなかった。
dialogue.local: Jesus wasn't there.
dialogue.en: Jesus wasn't there.

dialogue.text: He had come back to life just like he promised.
dialogue.zh: 他如同承諾的那樣復活了。
dialogue.ja: 彼は約束通りに生き返ったのだ。
dialogue.local: He had come back to life just like he promised.
dialogue.en: He had come back to life just like he promised.

dialogue.text: The angel told them,
dialogue.zh: 天使告訴他們，
dialogue.ja: 天使は彼らに言った、
dialogue.local: The angel told them,
dialogue.en: The angel told them,

dialogue.text: Jesus is alive.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌活著。
dialogue.ja: イエスは生きている。
dialogue.local: Jesus is alive.
dialogue.en: Jesus is alive.

dialogue.text: Joy filled their hearts.
dialogue.zh: 喜悅充滿了他們的心。
dialogue.ja: 喜びが彼らの心を満たした。
dialogue.local: Joy filled their hearts.
dialogue.en: Joy filled their hearts.

dialogue.text: Jesus had won.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌勝利了。
dialogue.ja: イエスは勝った。
dialogue.local: Jesus had won.
dialogue.en: Jesus had won.

dialogue.text: His love was stronger than death.
dialogue.zh: 他的愛比死亡更強大。
dialogue.ja: 彼の愛は死よりも強かった。
dialogue.local: His love was stronger than death.
dialogue.en: His love was stronger than death.

dialogue.text: And because of that,
dialogue.zh: 正因如此，
dialogue.ja: だからこそ、
dialogue.local: And because of that,
dialogue.en: And because of that,

dialogue.text: we never have to be afraid.
dialogue.zh: 我們永遠不必害怕。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは決して怖がる必要はない。
dialogue.local: we never have to be afraid.
dialogue.en: we never have to be afraid.

dialogue.text: Jesus appeared to his friends.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌向他的朋友顯現。
dialogue.ja: イエスは友達に現れた。
dialogue.local: Jesus appeared to his friends.
dialogue.en: Jesus appeared to his friends.

dialogue.text: To show them he was truly alive.
dialogue.zh: 向他們證明他真的活著。
dialogue.ja: 彼が本当に生きていることを示すために。
dialogue.local: To show them he was truly alive.
dialogue.en: To show them he was truly alive.

dialogue.text: He gave them hope and peace.
dialogue.zh: 他給了他們希望與平安。
dialogue.ja: 彼は彼らに希望と平和を与えた。
dialogue.local: He gave them hope and peace.
dialogue.en: He gave them hope and peace.

dialogue.text: And then one day he returned to heaven where he watches over us still.
dialogue.zh: 然後有一天，他回到了天堂，仍然守護著我們。
dialogue.ja: そしてある日、彼は天に戻り、今も私たちを見守っている。
dialogue.local: And then one day he returned to heaven where he watches over us still.
dialogue.en: And then one day he returned to heaven where he watches over us still.

dialogue.text: And that's the Easter story, my dear friend.
dialogue.zh: 這就是復活節的故事，我親愛的朋友。
dialogue.ja: それがイースターの物語だよ、親愛なる友よ。
dialogue.local: And that's the Easter story, my dear friend.
dialogue.en: And that's the Easter story, my dear friend.

dialogue.text: Jesus loved us so much that he gave his life to save us.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌如此愛我們，以至於他捨命拯救我們。
dialogue.ja: イエスは私たちをとても愛して、命を捧げて救ってくれた。
dialogue.local: Jesus loved us so much that he gave his life to save us.
dialogue.en: Jesus loved us so much that he gave his life to save us.

dialogue.text: And when everything seems sad and still, he came back just like he promised.
dialogue.zh: 當一切看似悲傷與寂靜時，他如約回來了。
dialogue.ja: すべてが悲しく静かに見えるとき、彼は約束通り戻ってきた。
dialogue.local: And when everything seems sad and still, he came back just like he promised.
dialogue.en: And when everything seems sad and still, he came back just like he promised.

dialogue.text: Jesus is alive and he's always with us.
dialogue.zh: 耶穌活著，他永遠與我們同在。
dialogue.ja: イエスは生きていて、いつも私たちと一緒にいる。
dialogue.local: Jesus is alive and he's always with us.
dialogue.en: Jesus is alive and he's always with us.

dialogue.text: That means we're never alone.
dialogue.zh: 這意味著我們永遠不孤單。
dialogue.ja: それは私たちが決して一人ではないということだ。
dialogue.local: That means we're never alone.
dialogue.en: That means we're never alone.

dialogue.text: Before we go to sleep, let's say our prayers.
dialogue.zh: 在我們睡覺前，讓我們一起禱告。
dialogue.ja: 寝る前に、一緒にお祈りしよう。
dialogue.local: Before we go to sleep, let's say our prayers.
dialogue.en: Before we go to sleep, let's say our prayers.

dialogue.text: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much.
dialogue.zh: 親愛的耶穌，謝謝你如此愛我。
dialogue.ja: 親愛なるイエス様、私をこんなに愛してくれてありがとう。
dialogue.local: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much.
dialogue.en: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much.

dialogue.text: Thank you for being brave and kind.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你勇敢又善良。
dialogue.ja: 勇敢で優しいあなたに感謝します。
dialogue.local: Thank you for being brave and kind.
dialogue.en: Thank you for being brave and kind.

dialogue.text: I'm so glad you are alive and with me always.
dialogue.zh: 我很高興你活著，並永遠與我同在。
dialogue.ja: あなたが生きていて、いつも私と一緒にいてくれて嬉しいです。
dialogue.local: I'm so glad you are alive and with me always.
dialogue.en: I'm so glad you are alive and with me always.

dialogue.text: Help me sleep in your peace tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚請幫助我在你的平安中入睡。
dialogue.ja: 今夜、あなたの平和の中で眠れるよう助けてください。
dialogue.local: Help me sleep in your peace tonight.
dialogue.en: Help me sleep in your peace tonight.

dialogue.text: Amen.
dialogue.zh: 阿門。
dialogue.ja: アーメン。
dialogue.local: Amen.
dialogue.en: Amen.
